name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2025-10-27.39.1) introduced by Indi MP [Helen Haines](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/indi/helen_haines) (Independent), which means it failed. ### What do these amendments do?
